services.name: Figure Skating/Freestyle
services.desc: Ice skating can be more than skating in circles! Learn how to figure skate from one of our amazing instructors! View the full session schedule

services.name: Ice Skating Lessons
services.desc: Jane Hottinger has been teaching skating for over 30 years. She is a Canadian Figure Skating Association Double Gold Medalist in Figures and Freestyle. Jane trained under former Olympians and has 16 Championship titles. She was Canadian Pair Silver Medalist and Canadian representative to the North American Skating Team. She specializes in Freestyle and Moves in the Field and enjoys working with skaters of all ages and abilities. Jamie Widener is a current competitive USFSA adult figure skater/Gold Medalist and private coach. Her coaching journey began as a Learn to Skate instructor 5 years ago at Greensboro Icehouse. She’s also a Ballroom Dancer & Instructor and has competed in Partnered

services.name: Bookings & Rentals
services.desc: Our venues are full service and supply all staffing and in-house resources to make your event as easy as possible for you. Resources include ticketing through Ticketmaster with a full-service box office, security, event staffing and personnel, catering through an in-house contracted third-party vendor. No outside staffing, food, or beverage services are permitted in the facilities for our events. All entertainment events are subject to up to a $2 Facility Fee which is passed to the consumer. There is a parking charge for all events at our facilities. For new clients, we require 100% of the rent and depending on the estimated staffing numbers, partial staffing payments. We do not CONSIGN

services.name: Fairgrounds Campground
services.desc: The RV Campground is available for use throughout the year with the exception of mid-September through mid-October due to the annual Carolina Classic Fair. Address for the campground is 569 Fairgrounds Blvd. Winston-Salem NC 27105. To enter, please turn right at Gate 7 into the campground. BOOK YOUR RESERVATION NOW!
